Worth the trip.

Places in this region people keep coming back to. Not a ranking — a starting point.

  • Wli Falls

    Ghana's highest waterfall, reached on a walk through forest.

    Visit Ghana guide ↗Wikipedia ↗

  • Mount Afadja

    The country's highest peak. Steep, but a short climb.

    Wikipedia ↗

  • Tafi Atome Monkey Sanctuary

    Mona monkeys living alongside the village that protects them.

    Visit Ghana guide ↗Wikipedia ↗

  • Amedzofe

    One of Ghana’s highest settlements, with the Ote waterfall below it.

    Wikipedia ↗

  • Keta Lagoon

    Sandbars, salt and birds between the lagoon and the sea.

    Wikipedia ↗
